faq.q: What is the origin of Minah?
faq.a: Minah is associated with Arabic. Minah is Arabic مِنْحَة (Minḥa) 'gift, grant, bestowal', from the root م ن ح (m-n-ḥ). The source gloss 'Gift from Allah' is broadly consistent.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Minah, minah. Script forms are منحة, منحه, منحہ, मिनहा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
